name: regulation and standards
reason: Effectively zero, and this is a deliberate statement rather than an omission. The repo defines no scope of authorisation, no disclosure procedure and no evidence handling standard. Every pattern carries an authorisation precondition, which is a rule in prose, not an artefact that a reader can run.

L13-025.note: A hardening baseline is one reading of a standard. Divergence between auditors is not tested.

L13-001.note: Scope is stated as a requirement in reporting practice. No artefact encodes what is in and out.

L13-005.note: No artefact addresses the legal limits of a test, which is a gap in a repo that claims authorisation is a precondition.
